title: Winning tactics: forks and skewers
source: Original positions composed for this project by games/compose-chess.ts and verified with chess.js (not taken from any game or puzzle database).

hints: Look for a knight move that attacks two valuable pieces at once.
puzzles.explain: A knight move that attacks two pieces at once is called a fork. This one attacks the king and the queen. Black can only deal with one of them, so White wins the other.

hints: Look for a check that lines the king up in front of a more valuable piece.
puzzles.explain: The rook gives check along a line, and the black king stands in front of a more valuable piece. The king must move out of the way, and then the rook captures what was behind it. This is called a skewer.
